evidence: The stated entry, port, health/root routes, PORT/NODE_PATH/PATH/DB_PATH, seed, server packages, arbitrary CWD and symlink restrictions otherwise match: task/environment/instructions/integration.md:3-15 versus task/tests/test.sh:48-56,68-111 and both Dockerfiles. Network remains public and no same-origin defect is asserted. Confirmed mismatch: frozen task/environment/instructions/integration.md:7 says "HOME points to the directory containing the running app copy." The normal writable-/app branch of tests/test.sh:97-111 launches /app/server.js and uses /app/app.db but sets HOME=/tmp/submission; restart lines 160-167 repeat that assignment. Task and frozen template test.sh both hash to bd68259276ca4b034654efc8a1723a4e702ed62dbe590af6201565f43eabe5aa, so this is a task-note contract defect, not authorization to change shared harness logic. CONFIRMED by row23-home-probe-v2/RESULTS.json, source-binding.json and case raw logs: exact frozen launch prefix through restart-helper generation ran in no-network disposable image sha256:46fefc505dbcabf0d6cb4e54fea8f0880acde2f7896587750af967427598977d, with fresh app/database and no published ports. A golden-derived server generated the same public/index.html bytes under HOME/public and served __dirname/public. With only HOME corrected to /app, GET / was 200 and its body SHA256 was the exact golden index hash 8d29a2ddbebbb17a2e1cb35f3b6eebef6ece5f8da8aedcacf11a39accddcf9d0; unchanged canonical launch produced GET / 404 while GET /api/health remained 200. The process logged /app/server.js and HOME=/tmp/submission. All v2 artifact and source-binding hashes verified. Weak-app control: a server returning 503 for every route passes the launcher reachability predicate because HTTPError is accepted (test.sh:51-52), but this is only liveness admission; Render/Constraints still perform actual outcome checks, and no claim that this weak app earns a score is made. The first probe attempt is preserved separately in row23-home-probe; its measurement failed on /proc environ permission and provides no verdict. No RewardKit, full configured judge, Oracle, model or hosted score was measured.
counterexample: A conforming implementation uses the explicitly documented HOME app directory to generate its HTML entry on startup, while Express serves the public directory relative to server.js. The tested alternative copies public/index.html.in to HOME/public/index.html and otherwise preserves the golden server, bundle and runtime behavior. It serves byte-identical golden HTML under the promised HOME=/app relationship, but the actual launcher generates the entry in /tmp/submission while serving /app/public, producing 404 for the workspace and exposing a correct-under-contract alternative to a gate failure. This is a demonstrated runtime false-fail mechanism, not a measured judge score.
suggested_fix: Correct the task-authored integration note to say HOME is a writable staging directory that can differ from the entrypoint directory; require resolving app files from the entrypoint/module location and continue honoring DB_PATH, while preserving the protected shared launcher.
